On Wed, Dec 15, 2021 at 10:30 AM Jared Ford <[contact omitted]>wrote:
Hi Sara,
Happy to prepare a rough draft of a readout in the model of this example. I've got two points in need of clarification:
1) I'm not planning on attending this meeting, so please confirm that the readout does not need to be prepared by
someone in attendance at the meeting. 2) The draft readout content will be based on the briefing memo and not
the meeting itself.
Thanks,
Jared

Hi Jared,
Please draft a readout of the Administrator's meeting with the President of Microsoft by COB today, 12/15.
Thanks,

Please see below to draft a readout.
Best,
Sofie
